To solve this problem, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is $50,$ and the percentage is $240%.$ 

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
240%=240÷100=2.4
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =240%\times 50 \\  & =2.4\times 50 \\  & =120\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $240%$ of $50$ is $120.$

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
240%=\frac{240}{100}=\frac{240÷20}{100÷20}=\frac{12}{5}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =240%\times 50 \\  & =\frac{12}{5}\times 50 \\  & =12\times \frac{50}{5} \\  & =12\times 10 \\  & =120\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $240%$ of $50$ is $120.$
